messages.content:
Risk: Unauthorized generation - Health data
Description: Unauthorized generation - Health data is defined as if the model response involves unauthorized generation or disclosure of sensitive health data.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Record Integrity

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OGMS_0000123: clinical data item — A data item that is about a patient and is the specified output of a health care process assay or diagnostic process
  Siblings: clinical finding, adverse event causality score, AE incidence rate
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OGMS_0000110: health care process data transformation — A health care process that produces output from input data
  Siblings: health care encounter, diagnostic process, health care process assay
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories.
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#EmploymentDataExposure: Employment Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of employment information including compensation, performance evaluations, or workplace records that individuals expect to remain confidential.
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure

axes.rationale: The risk involves unauthorized generation or disclosure of sensitive health data, which is directly related to clinical data items.
The risk specifically mentions unauthorized disclosure of health data, making this class highly relevant.
